description: Statutory revenue certificate certifying total annual household income across all legal sources for admissions, government scholarships, state subsidies, and fee remissions.
eligibility: Permanent resident of Uttarakhand or residing lawfully in the state with verifiable economic activity.
Head of family or applicant declaring lawful family income with supporting revenue evidence.
No duplicate active income certificate issued within the same financial year.

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / Photo ID
requiredDocuments.details: Self-attested identity proof with local Uttarakhand address.

requiredDocuments.name: Family Register (Parivar Register) Excerpt
requiredDocuments.details: Certified copy issued by Gram Panchayat Vikas Adhikari (VDO) in rural areas or Nagar Palika/Nigam tax record in urban areas.
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: Gram Panchayat Vikas Adhikari (VDO) / Nagar Palika

requiredDocuments.name: Self-Declaration / Income Affidavit
requiredDocuments.details: Prescribed affidavit on stamp paper or standard e-District self-declaration format declaring annual income.

requiredDocuments.name: Recent Passport Size Photograph
requiredDocuments.details: Color photograph with light/white background taken within recent 3 months.

requiredDocuments.name: Salary Slip / Employer Certificate / ITR
requiredDocuments.details: Mandatory only if any family member is employed in government/private sector or files income tax.

requiredDocuments.name: Land Record (Khatauni) / Agricultural Income Proof
requiredDocuments.details: Excerpts from Uttarakhand Bhulekh portal if family owns agricultural land.

applicationSteps.title: Registration on Apuni Sarkar Portal
applicationSteps.description: Create a citizen profile on eservices.uk.gov.in using mobile number and Aadhaar OTP verification.

applicationSteps.title: Select Service & Fill Family Income Details
applicationSteps.description: Choose Revenue Department -> Income Certificate. Enter district, tehsil, village/ward, and family income breakdown.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Scanned Documents
applicationSteps.description: Upload scanned copies of Parivar register excerpt, income affidavit, identity proof, and recent photograph.

applicationSteps.title: Pay Portal Fee & Obtain Application Receipt
applicationSteps.description: Pay statutory user fee online and note down the application reference tracking number (UK-REV-XXXX).

applicationSteps.title: Patwari Inquiry & Tehsildar Approval
applicationSteps.description: Lekhpal/Patwari conducts field revenue inquiry; Tehsildar issues digitally signed QR-coded certificate.

fees: ₹30 (Direct Online Portal submission) / ₹50 (Common Service Center CSC user fee)
processingTime: 15 working days under Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Act

sources.sourceTitle: Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Commission Service Delivery Schedule
sources.governmentDepartment: Uttarakhand Right to Service Commission & Revenue Department
sources.informationSupported: Statutory 15-day timeline, Tehsildar designated authority, mandatory Lekhpal inquiry
sources.officialReferenceNote: Notified under Uttarakhand Right to Service Act 2011, Schedule item for Revenue Services

sources.informationSupported: Document checklist, digital signing process, online payment fee structure

description: Official legal certificate validating membership in Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), or Other Backward Classes (OBC) for state reservations, education seats, and welfare schemes.
eligibility: Permanent resident of Uttarakhand holding valid ancestral domicile.
Belongs to a community recognized in the state SC, ST, or OBC presidential orders for Uttarakhand.
For OBC category: Household income must fall within Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) threshold as defined by government guidelines.

requiredDocuments.name: Applicant Identity Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID)
requiredDocuments.details: Government issued photo identification card.

requiredDocuments.name: Father's Caste Certificate or Pre-1985 Ancestral Caste Proof
requiredDocuments.details: Father or grandfather's revenue entry, land record (Khatauni), or earlier issued caste certificate.

requiredDocuments.name: Uttarakhand Permanent Residence (Domicile) Certificate
requiredDocuments.details: Mandatory to establish state origin eligibility.

requiredDocuments.name: Gram Panchayat Parivar Register Copy
requiredDocuments.details: Form-2 family register excerpt issued by Gram Vikas Adhikari (VDO) showing family pedigree.

requiredDocuments.name: Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Income Proof (For OBC Applicants)
requiredDocuments.details: Mandatory only for OBC applicants to verify non-creamy layer criteria.

requiredDocuments.name: Self-Declaration of Caste and Sub-Caste
requiredDocuments.details: Notarized affidavit or standard declaration declaring clan, sub-caste, and lineage.

applicationSteps.title: Portal Log in
applicationSteps.description: Log in to Apuni Sarkar portal (eservices.uk.gov.in) with registered citizen credentials.

applicationSteps.title: Select Caste Category
applicationSteps.description: Choose between Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), or Other Backward Classes (OBC).

applicationSteps.title: Fill Ancestral & Lineage Details
applicationSteps.description: Enter father's name, caste title, village, tehsil, and pre-1985 family residence proof.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Proofs & Submit
applicationSteps.description: Upload scanned copies of Parivar register, father's caste proof, Domicile, and self-declaration.

applicationSteps.title: Tehsil Inquiry & Issuance
applicationSteps.description: Revenue Inspector (Kanoongo) and Patwari examine records before Tehsildar issues signed certificate.

fees: ₹30 (Direct Online Portal submission) / ₹50 (Common Service Center CSC user fee)
processingTime: 15 working days for SC/ST; 30 working days for OBC (under Uttarakhand RTS Act)

sources.sourceTitle: Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Commission Notification - Revenue Services
sources.informationSupported: Statutory processing timelines (15 days SC/ST, 30 days OBC) and appellate hierarchy
sources.officialReferenceNote: RTS Schedule for Caste Verification and Field Inquiry Norms

serviceName: Domicile / Permanent Residence Certificate (स्थायी / मूल निवास प्रमाण पत्र)
description: Statutory certificate issued to prove legal domicile and permanent residence in Uttarakhand for state public exams, government recruitment, and education reservations.
eligibility: Citizen whose parents or ancestors have lived continuously in Uttarakhand for at least 15 years, OR
Has passed High School / Intermediate examination from recognized institutions within Uttarakhand with continuous stay criteria, OR
State government / autonomous body employee posted in Uttarakhand as per statutory criteria.

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID
requiredDocuments.details: Identity and address proof of applicant.

requiredDocuments.name: 15-Year Continuous Residence Proof in Uttarakhand
requiredDocuments.details: School leaving certificates, old electricity/water bills, continuous voter list entries, or legacy land records.
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: Educational Institution / Electricity Department / Election Commission

requiredDocuments.name: Ancestral Land Record (Khatauni) or House Registry
requiredDocuments.details: Proves hereditary immovable property ownership in Uttarakhand.

requiredDocuments.name: Parivar Register Copy (Form 2)
requiredDocuments.details: Gram Panchayat family register excerpt showing family settlement in Uttarakhand.

requiredDocuments.name: Self-Declaration / Domicile Affidavit
requiredDocuments.details: Notarized affidavit declaring that applicant does not claim domicile in any other Indian state.

requiredDocuments.name: Recent Passport Size Photograph
requiredDocuments.details: Color photograph taken within 3 months.

applicationSteps.title: Citizen Login on Apuni Sarkar
applicationSteps.description: Log into eservices.uk.gov.in using your citizen account.

applicationSteps.title: Select Domicile Application
applicationSteps.description: Choose Revenue Department -> Permanent Residence (Domicile) Certificate.

applicationSteps.title: Enter Residential & Educational History
applicationSteps.description: Provide proof of 15 years stay in Uttarakhand, education history, and ancestral village/town details.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Documents & Submit Application
applicationSteps.description: Upload Parivar register, educational records, affidavit, and address proofs.

applicationSteps.title: Field Revenue Inquiry & Tehsildar Digital Signature
applicationSteps.description: Patwari conducts spot verification of residence and Tehsildar issues digital certificate.

fees: ₹30 (Direct Online Portal submission) / ₹50 (Common Service Center CSC user fee)
processingTime: 15 working days under Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Act

sources.sourceTitle: Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Act Guidelines for Residence Certificates
sources.informationSupported: 15-day RTS timeline, Tehsildar issuing authority, Patwari verification rules
sources.officialReferenceNote: Statutory rule governing permanent residence / domicile certification in Uttarakhand

serviceName: EWS Certificate (आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्ग प्रमाण पत्र)
description: Statutory income and asset certificate issued to general category citizens eligible for 10% Economically Weaker Section reservation in central and state higher education admissions and public employment.
eligibility: Citizen belonging to General Category (not covered under reservation schemes for SC, ST, or OBC).
Gross annual family income from all sources (salary, agriculture, business, profession) is below ₹8 Lakh in the financial year prior to application.
Family does not own 5 acres or more of agricultural land, residential flat of 1000 sq ft or more, or notified municipal residential plot of 100/200 sq yards or more as per statutory limits.

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card / Photo ID of Applicant and Parents
requiredDocuments.details: Government photo identity proof.

requiredDocuments.name: Uttarakhand Domicile / Permanent Residence Certificate
requiredDocuments.details: To confirm applicant's bonafide Uttarakhand residency.

requiredDocuments.name: Parivar Register Copy (Form 2) / Ration Card
requiredDocuments.details: Shows household composition and family members count.
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: Gram Vikas Adhikari (VDO) / Food Civil Supplies Dept

requiredDocuments.name: Income Proof / ITR / Salary Slip of All Earning Family Members
requiredDocuments.details: Validates that gross family income is under ₹8,00,000 per annum.
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: Employer / Income Tax Department / Revenue Authority

requiredDocuments.name: Land Records (Khatauni) / House Registry / Municipal Property Tax Receipt
requiredDocuments.details: Verifies family immovable property assets do not exceed EWS ceiling.

requiredDocuments.name: Self-Declaration / Notarized EWS Affidavit
requiredDocuments.details: Prescribed format affirming general category status, family income, and asset ownership.

applicationSteps.title: Portal Login & Service Selection
applicationSteps.description: Log into eservices.uk.gov.in and select Revenue Department -> Economically Weaker Section (EWS) Certificate.

applicationSteps.title: Fill Family Income & Asset Declaration
applicationSteps.description: Enter comprehensive family income, agricultural land holdings, and residential property measurements.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Scanned Evidence
applicationSteps.description: Upload Domicile, Parivar register copy, ITR/Income declaration, property documents, and notarized affidavit.

applicationSteps.title: Submit & Pay Fee
applicationSteps.description: Pay statutory user fee online and generate application acknowledgment slip.

applicationSteps.title: Revenue Inquiry & Tehsildar Digital Issuance
applicationSteps.description: Lekhpal verifies land holdings and income on ground; Tehsildar signs valid EWS certificate.

fees: ₹30 (Direct Online Portal submission) / ₹50 (Common Service Center CSC user fee)
processingTime: 15 working days under Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Act

sources.sourceTitle: Uttarakhand Personnel & General Administration Dept Notification on EWS Reservation
sources.governmentDepartment: Revenue Department & Department of Personnel, Uttarakhand
sources.informationSupported: Income ceiling criteria (₹8 Lakh), asset exclusions, 15-day RTS delivery timeline
sources.officialReferenceNote: Government Order regarding Income and Asset Certificate for Economically Weaker Sections

serviceName: Character Certificate (चरित्र प्रमाण पत्र / पुलिस सत्यापन)
department: Home & Police Department / Revenue Department, Government of Uttarakhand
description: Official character and antecedents verification certificate issued after local police verification for government jobs, armed forces recruitment, private security clearances, and public contractor registrations.
eligibility: Resident of Uttarakhand with local residential address verification.
Applicant must have no adverse criminal record or pending non-bailable warrant in police records.
Must provide valid local references and proof of identity.

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / Passport
requiredDocuments.details: Government photo identity and age proof.
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: UIDAI / Election Commission / Ministry of External Affairs

requiredDocuments.name: Local Residence Proof (Domicile / Parivar Register / Utility Bill)
requiredDocuments.details: Validates current residence under local police station jurisdiction.

requiredDocuments.name: Two Character Recommendation Letters
requiredDocuments.details: Character reference from two Gazetted Officers, Gram Pradhan, Municipal Councilor, or school principal.

requiredDocuments.name: Recent Passport Size Photographs (3 copies)
requiredDocuments.details: Color photograph with light background.

requiredDocuments.name: Self-Declaration of No Criminal Record
requiredDocuments.details: Self-attested affidavit declaring that no criminal FIR or conviction is pending.

applicationSteps.title: Online Application Submission
applicationSteps.description: Apply online via Uttarakhand Police Citizen Portal (uttarakhandpolice.uk.gov.in) or Apuni Sarkar e-Services portal.

applicationSteps.title: Fill Details & Nominate Police Station
applicationSteps.description: Enter personal bio-data, present and permanent address, and select your jurisdiction Police Thana.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Documents & Pay Fee
applicationSteps.description: Upload photo, ID proof, address proof, recommendation letters, and pay the verification fee.

applicationSteps.title: Local Police Station Verification
applicationSteps.description: Station House Officer (SHO) / Beat Constable conducts local field verification and checks CCTNS crime records.

applicationSteps.title: Issuance by SP Office / SDM
applicationSteps.description: Superintendent of Police (SP) office or SDM approves and releases the digitally signed Character Certificate.

fees: ₹50 (Statutory police verification fee via online portal / treasury challan)
processingTime: 15 working days under Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Act
responsibleAuthority: Superintendent of Police (SP Office) / Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM)

sources.sourceTitle: Uttarakhand Police Citizen Charter & RTS Act Timelines
sources.informationSupported: 15 working days RTS delivery, CCTNS background verification, ₹50 statutory user fee
sources.officialReferenceNote: Uttarakhand Right to Service Commission notification for Police Character Verification

department: Medical Health & Family Welfare / Panchayati Raj / Urban Development
description: Statutory vital registration certificate legally establishing birth record, date of birth, parentage, and citizenship under the Registration of Births and Deaths (RBD) Act 1969.
eligibility: Any birth occurring within the territorial jurisdiction of Uttarakhand.
Parents, hospital authority, or legal guardian applying for registration.

requiredDocuments.name: Hospital Birth Slip / Discharge Card (Form 1)
requiredDocuments.details: Institutional birth certificate issued by Government/Private hospital or ANM/ASHA worker in home deliveries.

requiredDocuments.name: Parents' Aadhaar Card / Identity Proof
requiredDocuments.details: Photo identity of both mother and father.

requiredDocuments.name: Parents' Marriage Certificate or Joint Declaration
requiredDocuments.details: Helpful for establishing parental lineage.

requiredDocuments.name: Parivar Register Copy / Residence Proof of Parents
requiredDocuments.details: Gram Panchayat family register excerpt or municipal water/tax bill.

requiredDocuments.name: SDM Order / Delayed Registration Order (If after 1 year)
requiredDocuments.details: Mandatory only if birth was not registered within 365 days of occurrence.

applicationSteps.title: Hospital Reporting or Portal Entry
applicationSteps.description: For hospital deliveries, hospital automatically logs Form 1 on CRS portal (crsorgi.gov.in). For home births, report within 21 days to VDO (rural) or Registrar (urban).

applicationSteps.title: Citizen Application on Portal
applicationSteps.description: Access crsorgi.gov.in or Apuni Sarkar (eservices.uk.gov.in) -> Civil Registration.

applicationSteps.title: Enter Child & Parents Details
applicationSteps.description: Enter child's legal name, gender, exact date of birth, place of birth, and parents' Aadhaar details.

applicationSteps.title: Verification by Registrar
applicationSteps.description: Local Registrar of Births and Deaths (Gram Vikas Adhikari in rural, Municipal EO in urban) cross-verifies institutional records.

applicationSteps.title: Issuance of Certificate
applicationSteps.description: Download QR-coded, digitally signed Birth Certificate from portal or collect signed copy from Registrar office.

fees: Free of cost if reported within 21 days; ₹2 (delayed 21–30 days); ₹5 (delayed 30 days–1 year with Tehsildar approval); ₹10 + SDM permission order (after 1 year) under RBD Act
processingTime: 7 to 15 working days under Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Act
responsibleAuthority: Registrar of Births & Deaths (Gram Vikas Adhikari in rural / Nagar Palika Health Officer in urban)

sources.sourceTitle: Registration of Births and Deaths Act 1969 & Uttarakhand RBD Rules
sources.governmentDepartment: Office of the Registrar General of India & Directorate of Health, Uttarakhand
sources.informationSupported: Mandatory 21-day reporting window, fee exemptions, SDM delayed registration procedure
sources.officialReferenceNote: Statutory rules governing birth registration and delayed registration orders

department: Medical Health & Family Welfare / Panchayati Raj / Urban Development
description: Legal document confirming the date, fact, and cause of death of an individual for property inheritance, insurance claims, family pension sanctions, and bank account settlement.
eligibility: Death occurring within Uttarakhand jurisdiction.
Immediate family members (spouse, son, daughter, parents) or legal heirs.

requiredDocuments.name: Institutional Death Slip / Doctor Cause of Death Certificate (Form 2)
requiredDocuments.details: Hospital death certificate or medical practitioner summary stating cause of death.

requiredDocuments.name: Cremation / Burial Ground Receipt or Gram Pradhan Certificate
requiredDocuments.details: Receipt issued by burning ghat/crematorium or confirmation by Gram Pradhan for rural home death.
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: Crematorium / Shamshan Ghat Authority / Gram Pradhan

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card of the Deceased
requiredDocuments.details: Deceased person's identity proof.

requiredDocuments.name: Applicant Identity Proof & Relation Proof
requiredDocuments.details: Aadhaar card of legal heir and Parivar register copy showing relationship.

requiredDocuments.name: SDM Delayed Registration Order (If after 1 year)
requiredDocuments.details: Mandatory order from Sub-Divisional Magistrate if death was not registered within 1 year.

applicationSteps.title: Report Death within 21 Days
applicationSteps.description: Report death to local Registrar (VDO in Gram Panchayat or Municipal Health Officer in urban area).

applicationSteps.title: Portal Application Entry
applicationSteps.description: Submit details on crsorgi.gov.in or Apuni Sarkar portal (eservices.uk.gov.in).

applicationSteps.title: Upload Hospital Slip & Cremation Receipt
applicationSteps.description: Upload Doctor Form 2, cremation slip, deceased's ID, and applicant relationship proof.

applicationSteps.title: Verification by Registrar
applicationSteps.description: Local Registrar verifies hospital record or village death register.

applicationSteps.title: Download Signed Certificate
applicationSteps.description: Obtain digitally signed QR-coded Death Certificate.

fees: Free of cost within 21 days; ₹2 (delayed 21–30 days); ₹5 (delayed 30 days–1 year); ₹10 + SDM permission order (after 1 year) under RBD Act
processingTime: 7 to 15 working days under Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Act
responsibleAuthority: Registrar of Births & Deaths (Gram Vikas Adhikari in rural / Nagar Palika Health Officer in urban)

sources.sourceTitle: Registration of Births and Deaths Act 1969 & Uttarakhand RBD Guidelines
sources.governmentDepartment: Directorate of Health & Family Welfare, Uttarakhand
sources.informationSupported: Mandatory 21-day timeline, cremation slip requirement, SDM inquiry after 1 year
sources.officialReferenceNote: Statutory procedure for civil registration of deaths in Uttarakhand

department: Registration & Stamps Department / Women Empowerment & Child Development
description: Official legal registration of marriage under the Uttarakhand Compulsory Registration of Marriages Act and Hindu/Special Marriage Acts, required for joint bank accounts, visas, family welfare schemes, and property succession.
eligibility: Groom must be at least 21 years of age and Bride must be at least 18 years of age at the time of solemnization.
Marriage must have been solemnized in Uttarakhand, OR either spouse must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
Both parties give free mutual consent and are not in a prohibited relationship unless allowed by custom.

requiredDocuments.name: Age Proof of Bride and Groom
requiredDocuments.details: 10th Class Marksheet, Birth Certificate, or Passport of both spouses.
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: CBSE/State Board / Registrar of Births / MEA

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card and Residence Proof of Bride and Groom
requiredDocuments.details: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or Domicile Certificate of both parties.
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: UIDAI / Election Commission of India / Tehsildar

requiredDocuments.name: Solemnization Proof (Wedding Card / Priest Certificate / Mandir Certificate)
requiredDocuments.details: Printed marriage invitation card, Arya Samaj certificate, or priest/qazi declaration.

requiredDocuments.name: Joint Wedding Photographs
requiredDocuments.details: Postcard size joint photograph of bride and groom solemnizing wedding ceremonies.

requiredDocuments.name: Identity and Residence Proof of Two Adult Witnesses
requiredDocuments.details: Aadhaar Card or Voter ID of two witnesses who attended the ceremony.

requiredDocuments.name: Affidavit of Marital Status and Consent
requiredDocuments.details: Separate notarized affidavits affirming date, place, marital status, and nationality.

applicationSteps.title: Online Pre-Registration & Form Submission
applicationSteps.description: Visit the Uttarakhand Registration portal (registration.uk.gov.in or eservices.uk.gov.in) and fill the online marriage application.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Documents & Select Sub-Registrar Office (SRO)
applicationSteps.description: Upload scanned proofs of age, residence, wedding photos, and select the concerned Tehsil SRO jurisdiction.

applicationSteps.title: Pay Registration Fee & Book Appointment
applicationSteps.description: Pay the government statutory fee online and book an available slot for in-person appearance.

applicationSteps.title: Mandatory Physical Appearance before Sub-Registrar
applicationSteps.description: Both spouses and two adult witnesses must appear in person before the Sub-Registrar with original documents and photos.

applicationSteps.title: Certificate Issuance
applicationSteps.description: Sub-Registrar registers the marriage deed and issues the stamped, signed Marriage Registration Certificate.

fees: ₹50 (if registered within 90 days of solemnization); ₹100 (if registered after 90 days per statutory state notification)
processingTime: Same day or up to 3 working days upon physical appearance before Sub-Registrar
responsibleAuthority: Sub-Registrar of Assurances (उप निबंधक कार्यालय - SRO), Registration & Stamps Department

sources.sourceTitle: Uttarakhand Compulsory Registration of Marriages Act & Registration Dept Rules
sources.informationSupported: Mandatory physical appearance requirement, witness rules, ₹50/₹100 fee structure, 3-day turnaround
sources.officialReferenceNote: Statutory procedures governing registration of marriages across Uttarakhand Sub-Registrar offices

serviceName: Parivar Register Copy (परिवार रजिस्टर की नकल - कुटुम्ब रजिस्टर)
department: Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Uttarakhand
description: Official excerpt of Form-2 Kutumb Register maintained in every Gram Panchayat, documenting family members, head of household, resident lineage, and births/deaths for state certificates and pensions.
eligibility: Permanent or lawful resident of a rural Gram Panchayat in Uttarakhand.
Member of the household registered in the Gram Sabha Kutumb Register.

requiredDocuments.name: Applicant Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID)
requiredDocuments.details: Government photo identity proof.

requiredDocuments.name: Application Specifying Household Details & Ward Number
requiredDocuments.details: Application mentioning village, Gram Panchayat, block, name of head of household, and father/husband name.

requiredDocuments.name: Previous Ration Card / Old Parivar Register Slip (Optional)
requiredDocuments.details: Assists Gram Vikas Adhikari in quickly tracing the family register volume and page number.

applicationSteps.title: Apply Online or In-Person
applicationSteps.description: Apply online through Apuni Sarkar (eservices.uk.gov.in) -> Panchayati Raj Department, or submit a written request directly to your Gram Vikas Adhikari (VDO).

applicationSteps.title: Select District, Block & Gram Panchayat
applicationSteps.description: Select your exact administrative block and Gram Panchayat name to map the application to the responsible VDO.

applicationSteps.title: Register Verification by VDO
applicationSteps.description: The Gram Vikas Adhikari (Panchayat Secretary) inspects physical Form 2 Kutumb Register entries.

applicationSteps.title: Issue of Certified Copy
applicationSteps.description: VDO issues the attested, stamped certified copy with serial number and official seal.

fees: PENDING VERIFICATION: Nominal local user fee (typically ₹10–₹20 or free per individual Gram Sabha resolution)
processingTime: 7 working days under Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Act
responsibleAuthority: Gram Vikas Adhikari (VDO) / Panchayat Secretary, Panchayati Raj Department

sources.sourceTitle: Uttarakhand Panchayati Raj Act & Kutumb Register Rules (Form 2)
sources.governmentDepartment: Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Uttarakhand
sources.informationSupported: Form 2 register statutory custody with VDO, 7-day RTS timeline, requirement for revenue certificates
sources.officialReferenceNote: Statutory rules for maintenance and issuance of family register copies

department: Social Welfare Department (समाज कल्याण विभाग), Government of Uttarakhand
description: Monthly social security pension of ₹1,500/month disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to elderly citizens aged 60 and above living below poverty line or meeting income limits.
eligibility: Applicant must be 60 years of age or older.
Permanent resident of Uttarakhand holding valid domicile.
Family must be registered under Below Poverty Line (BPL) or monthly family income must not exceed ₹4,000 per month.
Applicant must not be receiving any other pension from Central/State Government, municipal bodies, or public undertakings.

requiredDocuments.name: Age Proof (10th Certificate / Voter ID / CMO Age Certificate)
requiredDocuments.details: Government document verifying applicant is 60 years or older.
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: Education Board / Election Commission / Chief Medical Officer

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card
requiredDocuments.details: Must be linked to mobile number and bank account for DBT payment.

requiredDocuments.name: BPL Ration Card or Tehsildar Income Certificate
requiredDocuments.details: Verifying household income does not exceed statutory welfare criteria.

requiredDocuments.name: Parivar Register Copy (Form 2)
requiredDocuments.details: Excerpt from Gram Panchayat proving family composition.

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar Seeded)
requiredDocuments.details: Core banking passbook copy showing Account Number, IFSC code, and branch.

requiredDocuments.name: Recent Passport Size Photograph
requiredDocuments.details: Color photograph taken within 3 months.

applicationSteps.title: Online Registration on Social Security Portal
applicationSteps.description: Visit the Uttarakhand Social Security Portal (ssp.uk.gov.in) and click 'Apply Online for Pension'.

applicationSteps.title: Fill Personal & Banking Details
applicationSteps.description: Enter Aadhaar number, age proof details, family income/BPL registration, and bank IFSC details.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Necessary Documents
applicationSteps.description: Upload scanned age proof, Parivar register excerpt, income proof, photo, and bank passbook.

applicationSteps.title: Physical Verification by BDO / ADO Social Welfare
applicationSteps.description: Assistant Development Officer (ADO Welfare) or Gram Vikas Adhikari verifies applicant status.

applicationSteps.title: Sanction by District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO)
applicationSteps.description: DSWO sanctions pension and monthly benefit of ₹1,500 is directly credited to bank account via PFMS/DBT.

fees: Free of cost (No government application fee)
processingTime: 30 to 45 working days for sanction after field verification
responsibleAuthority: District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO) / Block Development Officer (BDO)

sources.sourceTitle: Uttarakhand Social Security Pension Portal (SSP) Citizen Guidelines
sources.governmentDepartment: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand
sources.informationSupported: ₹1,500 monthly benefit rate, 60-year age limit, BPL/income ceiling, DBT bank linkage
sources.officialReferenceNote: Social Security Pension scheme rules under Directorate of Social Welfare Uttarakhand

serviceName: Widow / Destitute Woman Pension (विधवा / निराश्रित महिला पेंशन योजना)
department: Social Welfare Department (समाज कल्याण विभाग), Government of Uttarakhand
description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500/month disbursed directly to bank accounts of destitute widows and abandoned women residing in Uttarakhand to ensure social security.
eligibility: Widowed or destitute woman aged 18 years or above.
Permanent resident of Uttarakhand holding valid domicile.
Living below poverty line (BPL) or monthly family income not exceeding ₹4,000 per month.
Applicant has not remarried and is not receiving any other state or central pension.

requiredDocuments.name: Death Certificate of Husband
requiredDocuments.details: Statutory death certificate issued by Registrar of Births and Deaths.
requiredDocuments.issuingAuthority: Registrar of Births & Deaths (VDO / Nagar Palika)

requiredDocuments.name: Applicant Aadhaar Card
requiredDocuments.details: Proof of identity and address.

requiredDocuments.name: Parivar Register Copy (Form 2)
requiredDocuments.details: Gram Panchayat family register excerpt reflecting marital and widow status.

requiredDocuments.name: BPL Ration Card or Tehsildar Income Certificate
requiredDocuments.details: Proves economic destitution and eligibility for welfare grant.

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Passbook Copy (DBT Enabled)
requiredDocuments.details: Individual bank account with Aadhaar seeding for direct transfer.

requiredDocuments.name: Affidavit Affirming Non-Remarriage
requiredDocuments.details: Self-declaration that applicant has not remarried.

applicationSteps.title: Online Portal Registration
applicationSteps.description: Access Uttarakhand SSP Portal (ssp.uk.gov.in) and choose Widow Pension Scheme.

applicationSteps.title: Enter Husband Details & Upload Death Certificate
applicationSteps.description: Enter deceased husband's details and upload scanned copy of husband's death certificate.

applicationSteps.title: Submit Bank & Income Details
applicationSteps.description: Enter bank account details, IFSC code, and upload income proof/BPL card.

applicationSteps.title: Verification by Welfare Officer
applicationSteps.description: Assistant Development Officer (Welfare) conducts local verification.

applicationSteps.title: Sanction & Monthly DBT Disbursal
applicationSteps.description: DSWO issues pension sanction letter and ₹1,500/month is transferred via DBT.

responsibleAuthority: District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO), Social Welfare Department

sources.sourceTitle: Uttarakhand Social Welfare Department Scheme Charter - Widow Pension
sources.governmentDepartment: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand
sources.informationSupported: ₹1,500 monthly pension, death certificate requirement, 18-year minimum age, non-remarriage affidavit
sources.officialReferenceNote: Citizen charter for Destitute Widow Welfare Scheme

department: Social Welfare Department (समाज कल्याण विभाग), Government of Uttarakhand
description: Monthly disability pension of ₹1,500/month granted to persons with benchmark disabilities of 40% or more residing in Uttarakhand.
eligibility: Permanent resident of Uttarakhand holding valid domicile.
Person with a benchmark disability of 40% or higher certified by an authorized medical board.
Family income within prescribed state threshold or possessing BPL card.
Applicant must not be in receipt of any other pension scheme.

requiredDocuments.name: Disability Certificate or UDID Card (Minimum 40% Benchmark Disability)
requiredDocuments.details: Issued by Chief Medical Officer (CMO) or composite district hospital medical board.

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card
requiredDocuments.details: Identity and local residence proof.

requiredDocuments.name: Income Certificate / BPL Card
requiredDocuments.details: Income proof issued by Tehsildar or BPL family entry.

requiredDocuments.name: Parivar Register Copy (Form 2)
requiredDocuments.details: Gram Panchayat family register excerpt.

requiredDocuments.name: Bank Passbook with Aadhaar Seeding
requiredDocuments.details: Account details for direct electronic credit of pension.

requiredDocuments.name: Recent Color Photographs Showing Disability
requiredDocuments.details: Photograph displaying nature of physical handicap if applicable.

applicationSteps.title: Online Application Submission
applicationSteps.description: Visit ssp.uk.gov.in and choose Disability Pension Scheme.

applicationSteps.title: Enter UDID / CMO Certificate Number
applicationSteps.description: Enter disability registration number, percentage (>=40%), and certifying hospital details.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Medical Certificate & Documents
applicationSteps.description: Upload scanned copy of CMO Disability Certificate, Aadhaar, bank passbook, and photos.

applicationSteps.title: Verification by Social Welfare Inspector
applicationSteps.description: Block Welfare Officer verifies documents and checks eligibility criteria.

applicationSteps.title: Sanction by DSWO
applicationSteps.description: District Social Welfare Officer issues sanction and monthly pension is credited via DBT.

responsibleAuthority: District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO), Social Welfare Department

sources.sourceTitle: Uttarakhand Divyang Pension Guidelines & Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act
sources.governmentDepartment: Social Welfare Department & Health Department Uttarakhand
sources.informationSupported: 40% minimum disability threshold, CMO certification requirement, ₹1,500/month DBT rate
sources.officialReferenceNote: Statutory rules for Divyang Pension disbursal in Uttarakhand

serviceName: Disability Certificate & UDID Card (दिव्यांगता प्रमाण पत्र एवं यूडीआईडी कार्ड)
department: Medical Health & Family Welfare Department & Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
description: National Unique Disability ID (UDID) card and medical disability certificate issued after clinical evaluation by district hospital medical board for reservations, concessions, and welfare aids.
eligibility: Resident of Uttarakhand with congenital or acquired physical, visual, hearing, neurological, or intellectual impairment.
Person seeking benchmark disability certification under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act 2016.

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card / Address Proof of Uttarakhand
requiredDocuments.details: Valid identity and address proof.

requiredDocuments.name: Past Medical Records / Hospital Discharge Slips / Clinical Tests
requiredDocuments.details: Medical history documents showing diagnosis from government hospital or AIIMS/medical college.

requiredDocuments.name: Recent Color Photographs (Displaying Disability)
requiredDocuments.details: Two clear photographs showing physical handicap if visible.

applicationSteps.title: Register on Swavlamban UDID Portal
applicationSteps.description: Visit www.swavlambancard.gov.in and click 'Apply for Disability Certificate & UDID Card'.

applicationSteps.title: Fill Personal, Address & Disability Details
applicationSteps.description: Enter applicant details, type of disability (locomotor, visual, hearing, etc.), and select district hospital.

applicationSteps.title: Medical Board Clinical Assessment Appointment
applicationSteps.description: Receive date to appear before the Chief Medical Officer (CMO) Medical Assessment Board at the District Hospital.

applicationSteps.title: Evaluation by Medical Specialists
applicationSteps.description: Specialist doctors examine the patient, calculate disability percentage per central guidelines, and record findings.

applicationSteps.title: Generation of e-Disability Certificate & UDID Card
applicationSteps.description: CMO signs digitally; digital certificate can be downloaded online and physical laminated UDID card is posted to address.

fees: Free of cost (Medical evaluation and UDID card generation is free in all government hospitals)
processingTime: 15 to 30 days (depending on designated weekly CMO Medical Board assessment days)
responsibleAuthority: Chief Medical Officer (CMO) / District Medical Assessment Board

sources.sourceTitle: National UDID Portal & Ministry of Social Justice Guidelines
sources.governmentDepartment: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment & Department of Health, Uttarakhand
sources.informationSupported: RPwD Act 2016 disability categories, free clinical board evaluation, CMO issuing authority
sources.officialReferenceNote: Standard Operating Procedure for UDID card generation and medical board evaluation

serviceName: Scholarship Application Guidance (उत्तराखंड छात्रवृत्ति योजना मार्गदर्शन)
department: Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare & Minorities Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand
description: Complete guidance for Uttarakhand students applying for Pre-Matric and Post-Matric scholarships for SC, ST, OBC, EBC, and minority students through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) and State Welfare portal.
eligibility: Bonafide student holding permanent domicile of Uttarakhand.
Enrolled in recognized schools, colleges, ITIs, polytechnics, or universities.
Family income within specified category limits (e.g. up to ₹2.5 Lakh for SC/ST, up to ₹1.5–₹2.5 Lakh for OBC/EBC per state guidelines).
Passed previous academic examination with minimum requisite qualifying marks.

requiredDocuments.name: Current Bonafide Student Certificate / College Admission Fee Receipt
requiredDocuments.details: Issued by the current recognized school, college, or university.

requiredDocuments.name: Previous Year Examination Marksheet
requiredDocuments.details: Clear attested marksheet of previous class/semester.

requiredDocuments.name: Valid Tehsildar Income Certificate (Current Financial Year)
requiredDocuments.details: Must be valid for the current academic session and issued in student's or parent's name.

requiredDocuments.name: Uttarakhand Domicile / Permanent Residence Certificate
requiredDocuments.details: Proves state domicile entitlement.

requiredDocuments.name: Caste Certificate (For SC, ST, OBC applicants)
requiredDocuments.details: Mandatory for reserved category fee reimbursement.

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Passbook (Aadhaar Seeded)
requiredDocuments.details: Active bank account in student's own name linked to Aadhaar for DBT transfer.

applicationSteps.title: Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
applicationSteps.description: Visit scholarships.gov.in and register under State Schemes -> Uttarakhand.

applicationSteps.title: Complete One-Time Registration (OTR)
applicationSteps.description: Complete Aadhaar / Face-auth based OTR and obtain unique reference number.

applicationSteps.title: Fill Academic & Income Information
applicationSteps.description: Select your Uttarakhand scheme (Pre-Matric / Post-Matric), enter college course details, and enter income certificate number.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Documents & Submit to Institute
applicationSteps.description: Upload required proofs and submit hardcopy along with originals to the College Scholarship Nodal Officer.

applicationSteps.title: Two-Tier Verification (Institute & DSWO)
applicationSteps.description: Nodal Officer at college verifies enrollment within 15 days, followed by DSWO approval for DBT bank transfer.

fees: Free of cost (No application fees on National Scholarship Portal or State SSP)
processingTime: Subject to academic calendar & NSP verification cycle (Institute verification within 15 days of submission)
responsibleAuthority: Directorate of Social Welfare, Uttarakhand & District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO)

sources.sourceTitle: National Scholarship Portal & Uttarakhand Social Welfare Scholarship Manual
sources.governmentDepartment: Ministry of Electronics & IT & Social Welfare Dept, Uttarakhand
sources.informationSupported: Mandatory OTR procedure, valid Tehsildar income certificate requirement, two-tier verification rules
sources.officialReferenceNote: Guidelines for Pre/Post-Matric Scholarships for SC/ST/OBC/General EWS students in Uttarakhand

serviceName: Income Certificate for Scholarship Purposes (छात्रवृत्ति हेतु आय प्रमाण पत्र मार्गदर्शन)
department: Revenue Department & Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand
description: Specialized guidance on obtaining, structuring, and verifying an Income Certificate tailored specifically for student scholarship portals (NSP & State portal) where parental income declarations, validity periods, and format must strictly align with DBT criteria.
eligibility: Student or parent/guardian applying on behalf of a student enrolled in recognized education.
Resident of Uttarakhand.
Must accurately declare total household earnings of parents from all sources.

requiredDocuments.name: Student Admission Proof / College Identity Card
requiredDocuments.details: Proves bona fide requirement for educational scholarship.

requiredDocuments.name: Father / Mother Aadhaar Card and Student Aadhaar Card
requiredDocuments.details: Government photo identity proof.

requiredDocuments.name: Parivar Register Copy (Form 2)
requiredDocuments.details: Shows student's relationship with parent/earning family head.

requiredDocuments.name: Income Affidavit Declaring Purpose as Student Scholarship
requiredDocuments.details: Notarized affidavit stating family income specifically declaring it for scholarship submission.

requiredDocuments.name: Recent Passport Size Photographs of Student and Parent
requiredDocuments.details: Recent color photograph.

applicationSteps.title: Apply under Revenue Portal
applicationSteps.description: Log into eservices.uk.gov.in -> Revenue Department -> Income Certificate.

applicationSteps.title: Specify Scholarship Purpose in Application
applicationSteps.description: In the purpose column, explicitly select 'Scholarship / Education' so the Tehsildar issues the appropriate format.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Supporting Evidence & Parivar Register
applicationSteps.description: Upload college ID, parent's declaration, Parivar copy, and salary/land proofs.

applicationSteps.title: Lekhpal Field Inquiry & Tehsildar Digital Issuance
applicationSteps.description: Lekhpal verifies household income and Tehsildar approves digital certificate within 15 days.

applicationSteps.title: Link Certificate Number on NSP Portal
applicationSteps.description: Enter the issued certificate number (UK-REV-INC-XXXX) on the scholarship portal for instant e-verification.

fees: ₹30 (Direct Online Portal submission) / ₹50 (Common Service Center CSC user fee)
processingTime: 15 working days under Uttarakhand Right to Service (RTS) Act

sources.sourceTitle: Uttarakhand Revenue Department Order on Educational Income Certification
sources.governmentDepartment: Revenue Department & Social Welfare Department, Uttarakhand
sources.informationSupported: 15-day RTS timeline, requirement for matching parents' name on NSP, validity within current financial year
sources.officialReferenceNote: Instruction manual for income certificate integration with DBT scholarship schemes

serviceName: Khatauni / Land Records Information (भूलेख खतौनी / अधिकार अभिलेख ROR जानकारी)
department: Revenue Council (राजस्व परिषद), Government of Uttarakhand
description: Public online inspection and information regarding land ownership titles, Khasra numbers, land parcel area, account holder names, shares, and mortgages across all 13 districts of Uttarakhand on the Devbhoomi Bhulekh portal.
eligibility: Open public service accessible to all citizens, farmers, land purchasers, and legal heirs.
Requires knowledge of District, Tehsil, and Village (Gram) name.

requiredDocuments.name: Administrative Location Details
requiredDocuments.details: Name of District, Tehsil, and Village (Gram) where the land parcel is located.

requiredDocuments.name: Any One Land Identifier (Khasra No. / Khata No. / Gata No. / Landholder Name)
requiredDocuments.details: At least one identifying criterion to locate the specific Record of Rights (ROR) entry.

applicationSteps.title: Visit Devbhoomi Bhulekh Portal
applicationSteps.description: Go to the official Uttarakhand Bhulekh portal (bhulekh.uk.gov.in).

applicationSteps.title: Select District, Tehsil and Village
applicationSteps.description: Click 'View Khatauni (ROR)' and select your District, Tehsil, and Gram from the dropdown lists.

applicationSteps.title: Search by Khasra, Khata or Landowner Name
applicationSteps.description: Enter the Khasra number, Gata number, or search by typing the Hindi spelling of the landowner's name.

applicationSteps.title: Inspect Land Title & Encumbrances
applicationSteps.description: View complete land details including co-sharers, parcel area in Hectares/Nali, and any bank hypothecation / court stay remarks.

applicationSteps.title: Save / Print Informational Copy
applicationSteps.description: Download or print the informational Khatauni excerpt for personal reference.

fees: Free of cost to search and view online on bhulekh.uk.gov.in
responsibleAuthority: Registrar Qanungo / Tehsildar / Lekhpal (Patwari), Revenue Council Uttarakhand

sources.sourceTitle: Devbhoomi Uttarakhand Bhulekh Citizen Land Records System
sources.informationSupported: Free public search access, Record of Rights parameters, Khasra/Khata lookup methods
sources.officialReferenceNote: Citizen charter for Devbhoomi Bhulekh Land Records System

serviceName: Land Record Copy Guidance (प्रमाणित खतौनी नकल प्राप्त करने की प्रक्रिया)
description: Step-by-step guidance on obtaining an officially certified, stamped copy of Khatauni (Record of Rights) from the Tehsil Land Record Computer Center or Apuni Sarkar for court litigation, bank kisan credit cards (KCC), land registration, and mutation.
eligibility: Landowner, legal heir, authorized power of attorney holder, or person with legal interest in the revenue parcel.

requiredDocuments.name: Applicant Identity Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID)
requiredDocuments.details: Government photo identification card.

requiredDocuments.name: Land Identification Details (Village, Tehsil, Khata / Khasra Number)
requiredDocuments.details: Written application or Bhulekh printout mentioning the exact Khata number.

requiredDocuments.name: Proof of Interest (For Court / Bank Requirements)
requiredDocuments.details: Loan requirement letter or court summons if requested for certified legal submission.

applicationSteps.title: Identify Land Parcel on Bhulekh
applicationSteps.description: Obtain your Khata/Khasra number using the free bhulekh.uk.gov.in portal.

applicationSteps.title: Visit Tehsil Computer Center or Apply Online
applicationSteps.description: Visit the e-District Land Record Computer Center at your Tehsil, or apply via Apuni Sarkar e-services.

applicationSteps.title: Pay Statutory User Charge
applicationSteps.description: Pay the notified fee (₹15 for first page + ₹5 per additional page) at the Tehsil revenue counter.

applicationSteps.title: Verification & Embossed Stamping
applicationSteps.description: The Computer Operator prints the official ROR and the Registrar Qanungo (RQ) / Tehsildar affixes official seal and signature.

applicationSteps.title: Collect Certified Legal Copy
applicationSteps.description: Collect the certified stamped copy valid for court evidence, bank loans, and registry.

fees: ₹15 for the first page + ₹5 for each subsequent page (Notified Tehsil user charge per Revenue Council order)
processingTime: 1 to 3 working days at Tehsil computer center under RTS Act

sources.sourceTitle: Uttarakhand Revenue Council Guidelines on Certified Land Record Copies
sources.informationSupported: ₹15 first page + ₹5 per subsequent page fee, Registrar Qanungo attestation, 1-3 day RTS timeline
sources.officialReferenceNote: Statutory fee schedule for issuance of certified Khatauni copies in Uttarakhand

serviceName: Panchayati Raj Services (पंचायती राज सेवाएं - ग्राम पंचायत अनापत्ति एवं सेवाएं)
department: Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Uttarakhand
description: Rural citizen governance services including Gram Panchayat No-Objection Certificates (NOC) for domestic water/electricity connections, rural building permissions, Gram Sabha resolutions, and village-level welfare certifications.
eligibility: Permanent or residing citizen of the respective Gram Sabha in rural Uttarakhand.
Holding residential occupancy or lawful land holding within Gram Panchayat limits.

requiredDocuments.name: Applicant Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID)
requiredDocuments.details: Government photo identity proof.

requiredDocuments.name: Parivar Register Copy (Form 2)
requiredDocuments.details: Proof of membership in the local Gram Panchayat.

requiredDocuments.name: Land Ownership Proof / House Possession Proof in Gram Sabha
requiredDocuments.details: Khatauni excerpt or ancestral house tax receipt in Gram Sabha.

requiredDocuments.name: Application Stating Specific NOC Purpose
requiredDocuments.details: Written application specifying whether NOC is required for electricity connection, water supply, or building construction.

applicationSteps.title: Submit Application to Gram Pradhan / VDO
applicationSteps.description: Submit a formal application to the Gram Pradhan or Gram Vikas Adhikari during Panchayat working hours or Gram Sabha meeting.

applicationSteps.title: Verification of Property / Residential Status
applicationSteps.description: Gram Vikas Adhikari verifies local residence and checks that no Panchayat land encroachment exists.

applicationSteps.title: Panchayat Resolution / Scrutiny
applicationSteps.description: Gram Panchayat committee reviews application during monthly Panchayat meeting.

applicationSteps.title: Issuance of Stamped NOC
applicationSteps.description: Gram Pradhan and Gram Vikas Adhikari jointly sign and stamp the official NOC certificate.

fees: PENDING VERIFICATION: Determined by individual Gram Sabha bylaws; nominal fee (typically ₹20–₹50 or free) as per local Panchayat resolution
processingTime: 7 to 15 working days depending on Gram Sabha meeting schedule
responsibleAuthority: Gram Pradhan / Gram Vikas Adhikari (VDO), Panchayati Raj Department

sources.sourceTitle: Uttarakhand Panchayati Raj Act & Rural Citizen Charter
sources.governmentDepartment: Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Uttarakhand
sources.informationSupported: Joint Pradhan and VDO issuing authority, Gram Sabha meeting approval process, variable local bylaws fee
sources.officialReferenceNote: Operational rules for rural service delivery and No-Objection certification
